name: api-workbench
description: CipherDeck API Workbench inside VS Code. Requests run from the extension host, so there is no CORS.

apiWorkbench.allowInsecureTls.description: Accept self-signed HTTPS certificates (for local https:// servers only).

apiWorkbench.dataFilePath.description: Where collections, environments, history and settings are saved. Leave empty to use the extension's global storage folder. Supports an absolute path, ~/path, or a path relative to the first workspace folder.
